project_description: Decentralized Medical Record Verification on Aptos Blockchain - A privacy-first, tamper-resistant system for issuing and verifying one-time-use medical records

main_features.name: Medical Record Issuance
main_features.description: Issuers (hospitals, labs) can upload medical documents, encrypt them, and mint tokens on Aptos blockchain

main_features.name: File Encryption
main_features.description: All files are encrypted with AES-256-CBC before uploading to IPFS. Encryption key is 64 hex characters.

main_features.name: Blockchain Token Minting
main_features.description: Mint tokens on Aptos blockchain with document hash, IPFS CID, patient address, and record type

main_features.name: Patient Dashboard
main_features.description: Patients can view their medical records filtered by their wallet address. Only records where patient_address matches connected wallet are shown

main_features.name: Share Access Links
main_features.description: Generate secure verification links with decryption key in URL hash fragment (#key=...), NOT in query parameters

main_features.name: Zero-Knowledge Verification
main_features.description: Verifiers can view medical records using shared links. If no key is provided, no decryption attempt is made

main_features.name: Token Consumption
main_features.description: One-time-use tokens can be consumed to prevent double-claiming fraud

main_features.name: Document Verification
main_features.description: Verify token validity, document hash, IPFS CID, and issuer information

main_features.name: IPFS Storage
main_features.description: Encrypted files are stored on IPFS via Pinata. RecordType metadata is included for searchability

main_features.name: ML Fraud Detection
main_features.description: Optional ML service analyzes extracted PDF text for fraud detection

critical_security_features.description: Files MUST be encrypted (AES-256) before uploading to IPFS
Patient dashboard filters records by patient_address. Only records matching connected wallet are displayed
Decryption key MUST be in URL hash fragment (#key=...), NOT in query parameters (?key=...)
If URL has no #key= fragment, application MUST NOT attempt to decrypt
POST /api/decrypt-view MUST fail if wrong decryption key is provided

backend.description: Upload medical document, encrypt, and upload to IPFS
Decrypt and return document from IPFS using provided key

blockchain_functions.description: Mint a medical record token on Aptos blockchain
blockchain_functions.note: Payload must match Aptos Wallet Adapter v2 format

blockchain_functions.description: Get token details from blockchain. Returns 7 values: recordType, documentHash, ipfsCID, patientAddress, isConsumed, issuer, timestamp
Verify if token is valid and not consumed

critical: Share link key in hash fragment (not query params)
